1722-2034-3188-3583.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1722-2034-3188-3583.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Oloro triggers. Holding prioirty, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Oloro trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

5170-6132-7918-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

1981-2415-5931-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Funeral Room and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

969-4289-4770-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1115-5078-6650-8171.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
1115-5078-6650-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

730-1479-2841-8103.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Verdant Catacombs.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
730-1479-2841-8103.description:
Fetch a land using Verdant Catacombs.
When the fetched land enters, Emeria Angel and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Emeria Angel trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Angel from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Emeria Angel triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1981-2415-2438-3025.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

5166-5488--86.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause Indoraptor to take damage.
5166-5488--86.description:
Cause Indoraptor to take damage by any method.
Indoraptor triggers, dealing damage to an opponent.
Guilty Conscience triggers, dealing damage to Indoraptor.
Repeat from step 2.

2532-4617-4906-7895.notablePrerequisites:
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
2532-4617-4906-7895.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin by paying {2}, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Soulbright Flamekin's ability, targeting every other creature you control.
Resolve all Soulbright Flamekin abilities, adding eight {R} and giving creatures you control trample until end of turn.
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Jaxis' ability, targeting every other creature you control.
Resolve all Jaxis abilities, creating a token that's a copy of each other creature you control with haste.
Put the token Agrus Kos into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Agrus Kos and Little Bear tokens trigger.
Resolve the Agrus Kos trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Little Bear trigger, untapping Jaxis.
Repeat, using the Soulbright Flamekin token instead.

3177-3861-7857.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout.
Repeat.

215-969-1355.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four enchantments.
215-969-1355.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Sanctum Weaver from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Sanctum Weaver by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

423-1362-1437-3177--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1362-1437-3177--85.description:
Cast Sakura-Tribe Scout by paying {G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Sakura-Tribe Scout spell three times.
Resolve the first Sakura-Tribe Scout copy.
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your hand onto the battlefield.
Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, triggering Evolution Sage.
In response, activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any additional creature without summoning sickness you control

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

872-3147-3259--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
872-3147-3259--85--106.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

465-2292-4605-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Wormfang Drake and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Wormfang Drake.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
465-2292-4605-7260.notes: You can either cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand or for the harmonize cost, adjusting mana requirements accordingly.

4249-4499-7008.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to any color is at least 7.
4249-4499-7008.description:
Cast Badgermole Cub by paying {1}{G}.
When Badgermole Cub enters, it triggers, earthbending Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx.
Activate Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least seven mana of any color.
Badgermole Cub triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Badgermole Cub.
Repeat from step 2.

360-5670-6705.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
360-5670-6705.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1242-1323-3143-7014.notablePrerequisites:
Experiment Kraj and Xavier Sal do not have summoning sickness.
Cinderhaze Wretch and North Pole Patrol each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
You control at least one creature token.
1242-1323-3143-7014.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a -1/-1 counter from Experiment Kraj, creating a copy of any creature token you control.
Activate Experiment Kraj using North Pole Patrol's ability by tapping it, untapping Xavier Sal.
Repeat.

2498-2541-6824.description:
Activate Benthic Biomancer by paying {1}{U}, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to loot.
Sheoldred triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

632-3621-4659-5129-6633.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-3621-4659-5129-6633.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

4067-4851-6072-6281.description:
Activate Timeless Lotus by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Graveshifter.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Graveshifter that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Graveshifter token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Graveshifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Timeless Lotus.
Repeat.

800-4116-5168.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four colors among permanents you control.
800-4116-5168.description:
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Bloom Tender.
Activate Volrath by tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{G}{U}.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Knacksaw Clique.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}{U} and untapping it, exiling the top card of an opponent's library with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Repeat.
800-4116-5168.notes: If you control a white and a red permanent, this combo will net infinite white, black, red and green mana.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

3719-4893-5326-5400.manaNeeded: {U}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
3719-4893-5326-5400.notablePrerequisites: Synth Infiltrator has a power of at least 2.
3719-4893-5326-5400.description:
Cast The Master either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {U}{B} plus command tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Synth Infiltrator and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Synth Infiltrator to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Synth Infiltrator enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Synth Infiltrator by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

891-2386-4050-5220.notablePrerequisites: Pattern of Rebirth attached to Boonweaver Giant.
891-2386-4050-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant, adding one mana of any color.
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Mortuary and Pattern of Rebirth trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Boonweaver Giant on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Pattern of Rebirth trigger, putting Boonweaver Giant from your library onto the battlefield.
When Boonweaver Giant enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Pattern of Rebirth from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Repeat.

1651-3334-3715-5365.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one counter on a permanent you control.
1651-3334-3715-5365.description:
Activate Power Conduit by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, putting two +1/+1 counters on Lonis.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Clues, untapping Power Conduit.
Repeat.

uses.n: Valki, God of Lies // Tibalt, Cosmic Impostor

4944-5023.description:
Activate Valki by paying {0}.
Crackdown Construct triggers, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

722-1810-3153.description:
Cast Cackling Counterpart by paying {1}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Sphinx of the Second Sun.
Cast Chronomantic Escape by paying {4}{W}{W}, causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and exiling Chronomantic Escape with three time counters on it.
At the beginning of your postcombat main phase, Sphinx of the Second Sun and the Sphinx of the Second Sun token each trigger, causing you to get two additional beginning phases after this phase.
Move to your first additional beginning phase.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself and causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Chronomantic Escape,  causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and exiling Chronomantic Escape with three time counters on it.
Repeat from step 3.

549-1651-2034-4024.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Humans.
549-1651-2034-4024.description:
Activate Horn of Gondor by paying {3} and tapping it, creating at least three 1/1 Human Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Human Soldiers, untapping Horn of Gondor.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Human Soldiers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki

1537-1770-3337.notablePrerequisites:
Reflection of Kiki-Jiki does not have summoning sickness.
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1537-1770-3337.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Reflection of Kiki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Zealous Conscripts with haste.
When the Zealous Conscripts token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, untapping Reflection of Kiki-Jiki and the mana-producing creature.
Repeat.

1479-3875-4543.notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand.
1479-3875-4543.description:
Play a land card from your hand.
Kodama, Trench Behemoth and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield from your hand.
Resolve the Trench Behemoth trigger, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Food or a Treasure artifact token.
The Food or Treasure enters the battlefield, triggering Kodama.
Holding priority, activate Trench Behemoth by returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Trench Behemoth.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting a land onto the battlefield from your hand.
Trench Behemoth and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Repeat from step 5.
Once you have infinite Treasure and/or Food tokens, you may activate the Treasures for infinite mana, and then activate the Foods for infinite lifegain.

2560-2942-3059.description:
Cast Chandra's Ignition by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing Malignus to deal damage equal to three times its power to each other creature and each opponent.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

661-1651-1766-2645.description:
Activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Sculpting Steel and Staff of Domination, untapping Thran Dynamo.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Activate Sculpting Steel's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

1712-2034-2060-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jugan, adding {C}{C}.
Jugan dies, triggering itself and Nim Deathmantle.
Resolve the Jugan trigger, putting five +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {2}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Jugan from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

755-2437-4659.description:
Activate Helvault by paying {1} and tapping it, exiling Kami of Industry.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Helvault, adding {C}{C}.
Helvault leaves the battlefield, returning Kami of Industry from exile to the battlefield.
Kami of Industry enters the battlefield, returning Helvault from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2370-3389-4050.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}, attaching it to Bramble Elemental.
Bramble Elemental triggers, creating two 1/1  Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Saproling tokens, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
